The '''Tinn'lyi Islands''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]]. The natives of the islands, the [[Tinn'lyi]] nation, worked closely with the native [[selligore]]s.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
